feeds.title: Bladder Cancer Advocacy Network
feeds.description: The Bladder Cancer Advocacy Network, or BCAN, was founded in 2005 and is the only national advocacy organization devoted to advancing bladder cancer research and supporting those impacted by the disease. BCAN is on the front lines advocating for greater public awareness and increased funding for research to identify effective treatments and eventually, a cure for bladder cancer. Their blog features articles on the organization, their work, past clients, feature stories and more.

feeds.title: Ken's Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Ken's Cancer Blog is A journal of my battle with metastatic ('mets') muscle-invasive bladder cancer, chemotherapy, surgery, clinical trials, complete response ('CR'), relapses, and the joys and travails of life.

feeds.title: Bladder Cancer Canada Blog
feeds.description: BLADDER CANCER CANADA is the first and only Canadian patient advocacy organization dedicated to bladder cancer issues. We want to create awareness, support, and research to create a world where bladder cancer is just a memory. Follow our blog regularly to know more about us, our activities, feature stories on bladder cancer patients and more.

feeds.title: Bladder Cancer Australia News
feeds.description: Bladder Cancer Australia Charity Foundation is a registered not-for-profit foundation which has been established to increase public awareness of Bladder Cancer and to gain support from Government and to campaign for improved screening. Bladder Cancer Australia Charity Foundation aims to save lives & reduce costs through campaigning for early detection. The Bladder Cancer Australia website has a news section that provides updates on bladder cancer research, treatment, and support.

feeds.title: Bladder & Bowel Community News
feeds.description: At the Bladder & Bowel Community, we help support the millions of people in the UK who are living with conditions that affect their bladder or bowel. Whether you have a condition yourself or are a relative, friend, or carer of someone who does then you'll find all the support, information, guidance, and help you need. Follow thier blog section Featuring stories from our inspiring community, our news archive has information on products, support, and services for your bladder and bowel problems.

feeds.title: Science Daily News » Bladder Cancer
feeds.description: Visit ScienceDaily to read breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, and technology.Bladder cancer. Read about the latest medical research on bladder cancer and related topics.

feeds.title: Cxbladder Blog
feeds.description: Read the Cxbladder Blog and find helpful resources about bladder cancer to improve one's bladder health and overall well-being. Cxbladder is a urine-based genomic lab test that is accurate, easy to use, and clinically validated to rule out or detect the presence of bladder cancer.

feeds.title: Got Bladder Cancer?
feeds.description: Got Bladder Cancer blog is about the author's personal experience with bladder cancer. The blog contains information about the author's journey with the condition, including their diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. It also provides resources and information for others who are dealing with bladder cancer or who are interested in learning more about the condition.

feeds.title: My Bladder Cancer Journey
feeds.description: My Bladder Cancer Journey sheds light on Devied's bladder cancer journey. He writes about his treatments, how he was feeling at the time, his thoughts on the procedures, and more.

feeds.title: Nature » Bladder Cancer
feeds.description: Nature Portfolio is here to serve the research community by publishing its most significant discoveries and findings that advance knowledge and address some of the greatest challenges that we face as a society today. Our journals publish not only primary research but also reviews, critical comment, news, and analysis.
